generation_policy: Contract-gated: generated only for previously uncovered L2 features with a nonblank L2 what contract; contract contents are treated as provisionally correct per user instruction.

feature.description: Combine code, models, data, and interfaces into a bounded, runnable, and demonstrable proof of concept.

contract.purpose_user_function: Assemble code, models, data, and interfaces into a bounded runnable proof of concept.
contract.valid_inputs: Verified component artifacts, interface contracts, environment, configuration, data fixtures, run/demo procedure, and acceptance criteria.
contract.expected_outputs: Runnable prototype bundle/demo plus manifest, setup/run instructions, and verification evidence.
contract.state_side_effects: May assemble files, install dependencies in isolation, and run local demo processes.
contract.failure_rejection_behavior: Missing/incompatible component, broken interface, environment failure, unsafe dependency, or failed demo acceptance blocks completion.
contract.supported_boundaries_exclusions: Not found as a generic prototype assembler; individual demos and operator workflows are task-specific.
contract.success_evidence: Prototype starts in documented environment, executes bounded scenario, and produces expected visible/output evidence.
contract.granularity_atomic_contracts: component compatibility; setup; run; demo scenario; failure; cleanup; evidence.
